vBRIEFInfo.description: Stop pr:watch from premature STALL on stale-SHA confidence while re-review is in flight.

plan.title: bug(pr:watch): no premature STALL on stale-SHA confidence during re-review

narratives.Description: task pr:watch fires a premature STALL (exit 2) within about 90 to 106 seconds when a fresh commit has just been pushed and bots are still mid-review. It classifies confidence from a stale prior-SHA review (sha_match == false) as stall-eligible after a few polls instead of honoring the roughly 10-minute Stall Detection Rubric.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1. Align packages/core/src/pr-watch/watch.ts stall counter with sha_match gates and #1259 INCOMPLETE_BUT_RATED semantics so stale-SHA confidence does not accelerate early STALL. 2. Adjust packages/core/src/pr-watch/probe.ts / constants.ts if thresholds are shared. 3. Add regression covering fresh push + stale prior review remaining non-STALL until rubric threshold. 4. Verify with pnpm --filter @deftai/directive-core test -- pr-watch; CHANGELOG [Unreleased].
narratives.UserStory: As a review-cycle owner waiting on Greptile after a push, I want pr:watch to wait for HEAD reviews instead of stalling within about 90 seconds on a stale SHA, so that legitimate in-flight re-reviews are not aborted early.

items.title: Exclude stale-SHA confidence from early stall counter

narrative.Acceptance: Given sha_match == false on a prior-SHA confidence score, when pr:watch polls during re-review, then that score does not accelerate STALL before the rubric threshold.
Given a fixture that reproduces the #2311-class premature STALL, when pr-watch tests run, then they fail before the fix and pass after.
Given the fix lands, when CHANGELOG is reviewed, then [Unreleased] has a brief note for pr:watch stall behavior.

expected_outputs: no premature STALL on stale SHA
